issues.title: Inconsistent message bubble alignment
issues.description: Chat bubbles lack consistent sender-based horizontal alignment, producing an irregular visual flow.
issues.evidence: Multiple response bubbles show mismatched left and right offsets across the thread.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent left and right alignment classes for incoming and outgoing messages.
issues.triageNote: Geometrically verified in-browser: all incoming (start) bubbles share left edge 875px and all outgoing (end) bubbles share right edge 1391px on pair-039 — sender-based alignment is consistent by design; the auditor misread the intentional alternating chat layout.

issues.title: Unintended word fragmentation
issues.description: Several text strings inside bubbles exhibit broken spacing within words.
issues.evidence: Artifacts appear in words like 'Rever ted', 'Postmorte m', and 'Schedu led'.
issues.suggestion: Remove extraneous spacing in message strings and ensure standard word-break styling.
issues.triageNote: DOM text contains 'Reverted'/'Postmortem'/'Scheduled' with no stray spaces and computed styles are overflow-wrap:normal, word-break:normal, hyphens:manual — no fragmentation mechanism exists; small-text vision misread (JPEG artifacts).

issues.title: Misplaced bubble reaction
issues.description: Reaction badge is anchored to the left margin instead of aligning with the parent message.
issues.evidence: The eye reaction badge appears detached on the far left beneath right-aligned bubbles.
issues.suggestion: Align reaction badges directly beneath or adjacent to the associated message bubble.
issues.triageNote: Component correctly defaults reactions to the parent Bubble's alignment via context; the detached pill came from the explicit align="start" under end-aligned bubbles taught by the demos — removed it from reactions.tsx (×2) and bubble-group.tsx so reactions follow their bubble; pair-051's own instance is a frozen eval page that explicitly passes align="start" (composition, unfixable there).
